# sherpa-chart-legend

A legend for charts. Figma "Chart Legend" (1098:37846). A list, or a strip when its chart is square or narrower: its chart says.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | chart |
| Figma | Chart Legend |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.example.json) |

## When to use it

For the colour key of a chart, in the chart's `legend` slot. Its rows are toggles that report `legend-item-click`; `data-readonly` makes it a key only, as for a gauge's zones.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-chart-legend></sherpa-chart-legend>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-chart-legend`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Pro",
    "value": 12,
    "colorIndex": 1
  },
  {
    "label": "Team",
    "value": 8,
    "colorIndex": 2
  },
  {
    "label": "Free",
    "value": 3,
    "colorIndex": 3
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` |  |  |
| `data-bands` | text |  |  |
| `data-bucket` | `auto` `hour2` `day` `week` `month` `quarter` `year` |  |  |
| `data-chips` | boolean |  | each row a value chip, as a filter panel draws it: its swatch, its label, its count. Set by its provider. Will, TODO 586 |
| `data-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-highlight-hover` | boolean |  | a rest on a row says legend-hover. Set by its provider. TODO 495 |
| `data-over-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-readonly` | boolean |  | a KEY, not a filter: each row a light key, its swatch and its name, with nothing to press. TRAP T-readonly-legend-is-a-key-not-a-filter |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  | ASKED of its provider, or read off its chart: one row per value. A click narrows its chart alone |
| `data-where` | text |  |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `legend-item-click` | `{ active: boolean; index: number; indices: number[]; label: string }` |  |
| `legend-hover` | `{ label: string; on: false \| true }` | A pointer rests on a row, or leaves it. |
